candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, which order propagates as 502 to gateway checkout. Traces show payment 503 errors across all three correlation IDs while inventory/reservations succeed, localizing the failure to the payment dependency.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side logs or metrics; root cause within payment (config, saturation, dependency) not established.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations, order returning 502, and gateway checkout 502. Inventory and reservations succeed, so the fault is bounded to the payment dependency. Payment-internal cause remains unobserved.
